narr: A highly sheared and dynamic storm system produced numerous strong and severe thunderstorms during the afternoon and evening hours on February 17th. Several supercells developed along a pre-frontal trough, which produced a few tornadoes. Additionally, several rounds of heavy rain produced some flash flooding along and|north of I-20, and strong gradient winds ahead of the front caused scattered tree damage.
ev: Several roads flooded and impassable along and north of I-20.
Several roads flooded and impassable across southern Fayette County, including County Road 30 near the town of Berry.
Water, several feet deep, flowing over Messer Airport Highway. Village Creek at Avenue W rose to 10.89 feet. Flood stage is 10 feet.
Numerous roads flooded and impassable across Blount County. Blue Springs Creek at Blountsville rose above flood stage. Water several feet deep on roads in the cities of Oneonta and Blountsville.
